$\dfrac{aw_1+bw_2+cw_3+dw_4+ew_5}{w_1+w_2+w_3+w_4+w_5}=\dfrac{aw_1+bw_2+cw_3+dw_4+ew_5}{100}=k\ \left(say\right)$
This is out of 40 (as it is an average), and it is expressed as a number out of 100.
$hence,\ \ \dfrac{CS}{100}=\dfrac{k}{40}$​

The Composite Score will therefore be $=\frac{40\times\ 30+15\times\ 15+15\times\ 15+20\times\ 0+20X}{40}=\frac{1650+2X}{40}$​
As Ajay gets rejected from university Q, his Composite Score has to be less than the minimum required, which is given as 59
So, $\dfrac{1650+20X}{40}<59$ 
$or,\ \ X<\dfrac{59\times\ 40-1650}{20}=35.5$
Hence, the maximum value of X is 35, ie the maximum Ajay can score and still not be accepted despite being eligible.

Either Bhuvan can be placed in team 1 or in team 2. And the same goes for Eshan.
Now, if Chetan is selected, as per clue 4, Eshan cannot be selected. Since Eshan is already selected, Chetan cannot be selected. We have to take two boys on each team. Also, as per clue 7, Disha cannot be selected if Bhuvan is selected. Now, we are left with two more girls, and since there are two girls in each team, the remaining two will be chosen.
